title: Sundance Development Track 2028: Screenwriters Intensive (online) and Lab
summary: For writers and writer/director teams developing a first or second fiction feature. The Screenwriters Intensive is a two-day online program with writing workshops, group discussions and two individual script consultations. The Screenwriters Lab is a six-day in-person program in Utah with one-on-one creative advisors. No program fees; the application fee is $40.
note: Applications are not open yet. The 2027 session dates shown on the source are March 4-5 (Intensive) and January 15-20 (Lab).
eligibility: First or second fiction feature (Lab); first-time fiction feature writers, priority to artists from traditionally underrepresented communities (Intensive).
